memories.text: User prefers concise code reviews with actionable diff snippets.
Project hippo utilizes local single-binary Qdrant vector database listening on port 6333.
User configured Surge proxy outbound rules to direct domestic traffic via Direct policy.
Hippo Spool queue operates as an append-only write-ahead log located at ~/.hippo/spool.
User switched default Python tooling from Poetry to uv in February 2024.
Hippo implements an untrusted context envelope to sanitize external memory injections.
Deprecated SQLite vector storage backend was decommissioned in favor of Qdrant.
Documentation is built using VitePress with pnpm package manager in docs directory.
